distance_rule: distance_pc = 1000 / parallax_mas after each preset's declared quality cuts
spectral_rule: spectral_class is a BP-RP display-color proxy, not a spectroscopic classification
andromeda_boundary: Gaia cone rows in the M31 direction remain Milky Way foreground; only the separately sourced M31 core reference uses the Andromeda carrier.

presets.adql:
SELECT TOP 120 source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error,
parallax_over_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, ref_epoch,
phot_variable_flag, non_single_star
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE parallax > 10
AND parallax_over_error >= 10
AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 8
AND ruwe < 1.4
ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC
presets.boundary: Inverse-parallax display distance after declared quality cuts; not a complete nearby-star census.

presets.adql:
SELECT TOP 120 source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error,
parallax_over_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, ref_epoch,
phot_variable_flag, non_single_star
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(
  POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
  CIRCLE('ICRS', 101.28715533, -16.71611586, 5.0)
)
AND parallax > 0
AND parallax_over_error >= 10
AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 15
AND ruwe < 1.4
presets.boundary: Gaia quality-cut field around the Sirius direction; proximity on screen is not physical association.

presets.adql:
SELECT TOP 120 source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error,
parallax_over_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, ref_epoch,
phot_variable_flag, non_single_star
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(
  POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
  CIRCLE('ICRS', 10.6847083, 41.26875, 2.0)
)
AND parallax > 0
AND parallax_over_error >= 5
AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 18
AND ruwe < 1.4
presets.boundary: Gaia sources in the M31 sightline are retained as Milky Way foreground unless a separate membership source says otherwise.
